headlines.title: The peso breaks ₱63 to the dollar for the first time
headlines.line: Analysts tie the slide to high oil prices, which raise demand for dollars.

headlines.title: Inflation jumps to 7.2% in September, a three-year high
headlines.line: Food, transport, and utilities led the rise, ending four months of easing.

headlines.title: The House passes the ₱7.2-trillion 2027 national budget
headlines.line: The bill now goes to the Senate, which aims to have it signed before Christmas.

headlines.title: The BSP says to “prepare for the worst” as El Niño threatens prices and supplies
headlines.line: The warning comes a week before the central bank’s October 22 rate decision.

headlines.title: Malaysia’s CIMB is said to be considering a sale of its Philippine business
headlines.line: A deal could value the unit at up to US$200 million.
